issues.title: Godot re-targeting
issues.author: TheWhiteGuardian
issues.body:
Hi OpenRAC team!
I believe I may have created a small problem for myself. Having set up OpenRAC on a different machine, I provided it with Godot version 4.4.1 to work with. It seems this version of Godot does not appreciate the collision script provided by OpenRAC. I've since downloaded Godot version 4.7.2 (latest as of writing), but I don't see how I can tell OpenRAC to use this version of Godot instead. How can one update the version of Godot that the level editor opens?
